what: The shop takeover (Nate, product/words.md 2026-11-15): Buy's field pressed turns the page white with the field focused; a search builds as each source lands, its logo first and its listings beside it; then the answer, and the bar drops to the bottom and it is a chat. Closing keeps the chat on this device, never on our servers.
frame: Who: anyone, signed out; search is the one flow a visitor runs end to end.
Came to do: find the thing for sale across the sites, then ask about what came back.
Where a mistake costs most: a source that failed or ran late read as having nothing, a number no frame said, a chat that leaves the phone.
decisions: Each source comes in as its logo when the job asks it and its listings slide in beside it as its frame lands (research/buy/nate/search-in-progress.md, patterns 1 and 3); a failed or late one stays, faded, with why.
After the first answer, where it looked folds into one line of logos and counts that opens again (pattern 4), and nothing says Where we looked or For sale (Nate).
The first row large with View listing, the next on a shelf of Tiles, then the spread of asks: no price verdict, since a search row carries no fair range.
White with black type whatever the phone's mode (Nate: "turning everything in the background white").
Later asks go to the buying conversation; until it answers a visitor, the turn says it couldn't answer, never an invented reply.
